title.zh: 将东达沃-苏里高海岸公路沿线自孔波斯特拉谷省与东达沃省边界起的一段国家公路命名的法案
title.en: An Act Naming a Stretch of the National Highway Along the Davao Oriental - Surigao Coastal Road Which Begins At the Boundary of the Provinces of Compostela Valley and Davao Oriental Up to
title.orig: An Act Naming a Stretch of the National Highway Along the Davao Oriental - Surigao Coastal Road Which Begins At the Boundary of the Provinces of Compostela Valley and Davao Oriental Up to

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9703_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: A Stretch of the national highway along the Davao Oriental-Surigao Coastal Road which begins at the boundary of the provinces of Compostela Valley and Davao Oriental at Barangay Pintatagan, Municipality of Banaybanay traversing the municipalities of Lupon and San Isidro up to the boundary of the First and Second Districts of the Province of Davao Oriental at Barangay Mayo in the City of Mati, Province of Davao Oriental shall hereinafter be known as the Pres. Diosdado P. Macapagal National Highway.
The Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
